manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
description:
Activate Breaching Hippocamp using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Breaching Hippocamp to Yenna and causing Breaching Hippocamp to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Breaching Hippocamp.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Breaching Hippocamp token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
